[[File:GEMP LOTR play.lotrtcgpc.net login.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Lord of the Rings TCG GEMP login, 2026]]

'''GEMP''' (from Gempukku) is a browser rules engine for customizable card games with server-adjudicated play.<ref name="lotrreadme" /><ref name="historyvid" /> [[Marcin Sciesinski]] created it in 2011.<ref name="t7301" /><ref name="ghname" /><ref name="historyvid" /> The first public table was for [[The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game]].<ref name="t7476" /> [[Troy Biesterfeld]] forked Star Wars CCG from GEMP in 2013.<ref name="t52222" /> The [[Players Committee]] hosts a Star Wars CCG table at gemp.starwarsccg.org.<ref name="pcgemp" /><ref name="pcpublic" /> The table at play.swccg.com is an independent table that descends from a copy of the Players Committee GEMP.<ref name="readme" /><ref name="billcopy" /><ref name="historyvid" />

Players used [[Holotable]] for online play before GEMP.

== Name ==

GEMP is short for Gempukku, the coming-of-age ceremony in ''Legend of the Five Rings''.<ref name="historyvid" /><ref name="t7301" /> The name is a play on Apprentice, a ''Magic: The Gathering'' online client.<ref name="historyvid" />

== Origin ==

On 9 August 2011, Sciesinski proposed a browser client for The Lord of the Rings TCG on the Last Homely House forums.<ref name="t7301" /> He had written the first client for playing Legend of the Five Rings online, named Gempukku.<ref name="t7301" /> The first public beta of Gemp-LotR opened on 17 September 2011 at gempukku.com/gemp-lotr.<ref name="t7476" />

== Lord of the Rings TCG ==

LOTR TCG GEMP is hosted by the Player's Council at play.lotrtcgpc.net.<ref name="lotrreadme" /><ref name="lotrhome" /> [[Christian McCarty]] is the maintainer of LOTR TCG GEMP.<ref name="teltura" /><ref name="lotrreadme" /> The Player's Council About page says the Star Wars Players Committee uses the same software.<ref name="lotrabout" />

== Star Wars CCG ==

=== Players Committee GEMP ===

On 29 August 2013, Biesterfeld posted that he had started a project based on Gemp-LotR for Star Wars CCG.<ref name="t52222" /> The first table ran at tlbiesterfeld.servegame.com/gemp-swccg.<ref name="t52222" /> In June 2018 he stepped away, and the Players Committee took over management.<ref name="gemp2018" /> The Players Committee table is at gemp.starwarsccg.org/gemp-swccg/.<ref name="pcgemp" /> On 1 September 2020 the Players Committee announced that GEMP source code was on GitHub.<ref name="t76260" /><ref name="pcpublic" />

=== play.swccg.com ===

play.swccg.com is an independent Star Wars CCG table.<ref name="play" /><ref name="readme" /> It descends from a copy of the Players Committee GEMP.<ref name="billcopy" /><ref name="readme" /> Championship tables load Decipher and Players Committee cards. Fan products stay in isolated formats; see [[Custom formats]]. Planned work, including further [[Anything Goes]] rules and a [[True Sabacc]] game mode, is listed on [[GEMP planned features]].
